# Gianluca Orpello

> iOS Engineer and Developer Educator based in Naples, Italy. EU citizen, open to remote roles and relocation.

Gianluca Orpello is an iOS Engineer with 8 years of Swift and SwiftUI. He spent six years (2019–2025) as an Apple Certified Trainer delivering Apple-authorised training to engineering teams at dozens of enterprise clients, and four years (2021–2025) as faculty at the Apple Developer Academy in Naples, where he coached a cohort of 400+ developers through daily code review, spoke at Academy conferences and led the organisation of the Academy Future Fair in 2024 and 2025. He co-founded Tilted Penguins (morganize.it, assets acquired by a private investor) and Unicorn Donkeys, where he is Co-Founder and Tech Lead building Defenso.it and Quobe.

## Core expertise

- Swift and SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency (8 years)
- The Composable Architecture (TCA), MVVM, modular architecture
- Apple frameworks: CloudKit, SwiftData / Core Data, AVFoundation, PencilKit, VisionKit, Core Spotlight, visionOS
- Backend: Server-Side Swift, REST APIs, GitHub Actions, CI/CD
- Developer education: Apple-authorised training, technical writing, conference talks, workshops, event organisation

## Experience

- Co-Founder & Tech Lead, Unicorn Donkeys (June 2025 – present): Defenso.it (legal-workflow automation) and Quobe (social reading app, launching October 2026)
- iOS Engineer & Faculty Member, Apple Developer Academy, Naples (October 2021 – June 2025)
- Apple Certified Trainer, Apple / LearnQuest, freelance (September 2019 – 2025)
- Technical Writer & Speaker, Create with Swift, freelance (October 2021 – June 2025)
- Co-Founder & Lead Software Engineer, Tilted Penguins s.r.l.s. (2018 – 2019): built morganize.it, assets acquired by a private investor
- iOS Developer Intern, Apple Developer Academy, Naples (September 2018 – August 2019)
- Full-Stack Developer Intern, Gulliver s.r.l., Brescia (February – July 2018)

## Education

- BSc Computer Engineering and Automation, eCampus University (2026)
- World Class Developer, Apple Developer Academy, University of Naples Federico II (2017 – 2018)

## Apps

- Quobe (iOS) — social reading clubs with shared passages. Launching October 2026.
- Privacy Form (iOS, iPadOS) — event-consent platform used at events with 3,000–4,000 attendees.
- Outsoon (iOS) — movie tracker built with TCA and Swift Concurrency.
- MindLand (iOS) — sleep analysis rendered as an interactive 3D island.
- Delegibus (macOS, iPadOS, iOS) — Italian law in Spotlight search, Server-Side Swift backend.
- QRSwift (macOS) — privacy-first menu-bar QR generator.
